name: Tanaka Hanako
source: [url=/c5399]Renna's[/url] childhood friend. She's the cutest member of the Enoshima gang and likes to be petted even though she doesn't like to admit it. She's physically weak and doesn't know how to fight but is well versed in exploiting her appearance to inspire mercy, completely confusing her enemies and giving her the chance to hit.
